## Description {#details}

µTest++ is a modern C++ source code library that provides a lightweight and efficient testing framework, purpose-built for embedded systems development.

The framework offers a clean and expressive C++ API, enabling developers to write, organise, and execute unit tests with minimal overhead. µTest++ supports advanced features such as test suites, test cases, and detailed reporting, all tailored to the unique requirements of embedded environments.

Test output verbosity can be finely controlled via command-line options, allowing users to select the level of detail most appropriate for their workflow, from concise summaries to comprehensive diagnostic information.

By integrating µTest++ into your project, you can ensure robust and maintainable code through systematic and automated testing, supporting professional software engineering practices across all files and folders.
